In addition, the Venezuelan team has just lost 2-0 to Canada in their latest friendly and is looking to react in the FIFA Series.Venezuela will share group with Trinidad and Tobago, Uzbekistan and Gabon in the 2026 FIFA Series, where it will play two matches on 27 and 30 March. This friendly tournament brings together teams from different confederations as international preparation, and represents an opportunity for Vinotinto to add victories and start the year with good feelings.
